text: At 31 December 2025 the Public Investment Fund of Saudi Arabia held 9.97% of Telefónica's voting rights, indirectly through Green Bridge Investment Company SCS, which is controlled by Saudi Telecom Company (stc), itself controlled by PIF; the same report lists SEPI (Spanish state holding company) at 10.00% and says no person or entity exercises control over Telefónica.
short: PIF holds 9.97% of Telefónica indirectly via Green Bridge / stc; SEPI 10%; no controlling shareholder.

source.name: Telefónica: Annual Report on Corporate Governance 2025 (PDF), section 4.2.2 Significant Shareholders
source.quote: The indirect stake is hold through Green Bridge Investment Company SCS (a company controlled by Saudi Telecom Company which in turn is controlled by Public Investment Fund).
source.note: PDF pp. 12 and 75 (printed)/A.2 table: 'Sociedad Estatal de Participaciones Industriales (SEPI) 10.00' and 'Public Investment Fund 0.00 9.97 0.00 0.00 9.97'; section 4.2.2 states there is no individual or legal entity that exercises or may exercise control over Telefónica.

additionalSources.name: Data Center Dynamics: 'STC secures Spanish gov't approval to snap up 9.9% stake in Telefónica'
additionalSources.quote: STC is able to increase its voting rights from 4.97 percent to 9.97 percent and the right to appoint a board member in Telefónica
additionalSources.note: The same report states: 'The company is 64 percent owned by the sovereign wealth fund of Saudi Arabia, the Public Investment Fund (PIF).'

additionalSources.name: Cinco Días (El País): 'STC convierte por fin su 5% de Telefónica y alcanza el 9,97% del capital'
additionalSources.quote: ha convertido en acciones el 5% que posee en derivados para alcanzar el 9,97% del capital de Telefónica
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'converted into shares the 5% it held in derivatives to reach 9.97% of Telefónica's capital'. The article also describes stc as 'participada mayoritariamente por el fondo soberano PIF de Arabia Saudí' (majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's sovereign fund PIF).
